name: Amazon Kendra Web Crawler
description: The web crawler AWS runs for Amazon Kendra, its enterprise search service, which fetches the site URLs an AWS customer has configured as a data source and indexes them for that customer. Like the Bedrock knowledge-base crawler it is customer-directed but operator-run, and AWS states that customers must only point it at their own pages or pages they are authorised to index, and that using it to aggressively crawl sites the customer does not own is not acceptable use.
